name: cuecard
description: Responsible live preparation assistant with context-grounded speaking cues

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check renderer.js && node --check live-transcription.js

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: CueCard uses your microphone when you enable My Mic.
